newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's 9-month insurance premiums down 0.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's 9-month insurance premiums down 0.7 pct.

text.p: Brazilian insurance premiums in the first nine months of the year dropped 0.7 percent to 11 billion reais ($10.6 billion) over the same period in 1995, the National Federation of Insurance Firms (Fenaseg) said.
Fenaseg said in a statement that car insurance accounted for 30.3 percent of all premiums and health and life insurance accounted for 19.6 and 18.6 percent, respectively.
Fenaseg said capitalization market revenues between January and September increased 101 percent to 3 billion reais ($2.9 billion) over the same period last year.
